page_summary: This section discusses the importance of conducting vulnerability scans to identify weaknesses in port systems. It highlights that high-income countries conduct these scans more frequently compared to middle and low-income countries. The findings emphasize the need for routine scanning to mitigate risks associated with cybersecurity threats.

regions.label: Figure 8
regions.description: A bar chart showing the frequency of conducting vulnerability scans or pentesting across different income levels. The chart includes categories for 'Quarterly or more often', 'Annually', 'Less than once a year', 'Never', and 'Prefer not to say', with percentage responses for each income category.
